channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu meets with UAE President to discuss bilateral relations in Abu Dhabi.
item.description: How three distinct media landscapes transformed a single diplomatic meeting into three vastly different narratives of survival, scrutiny, and scandal.

item.title: U.S. Ambassador states Donald Trump offered to sell weapons to China during Xi's visit.
item.description: How different geopolitical prisms refract a single, startling claim of American arms diplomacy.

item.title: Donald Trump denies reports that he offered Iran sanctions relief for nuclear concessions.
item.description: How the same denial of Iranian concessions serves two different geopolitical scripts.
